summary: Full-stack testing of NUSA MVP. Executed 28 pytest backend tests covering auth, RBAC, analytics/pulse math, reports (analyze+create+status), finance CRUD/balance, residents/households, announcements, AI ask, monthly AI report, superadmin. All 28 backend tests PASS (after adjusting 2 test assertions to actual API contract). Frontend Playwright E2E covered: login (all 3 demo roles), RBAC redirects (resident→/admin→/resident, admin→/superadmin→/admin, unauth→/admin→/login), resident dashboard snapshot cards, Smart Report end-to-end with real PNG upload → AI analysis result with all 5 fields → submit → redirect and item visible top of /resident/reports, admin report status change persists after reload, all 5 filters present, Drainase filter narrows list to 5, Ask NUSA (admin/ai) returns Indonesian grounded answer citing balance Rp 12.500.000, announcement creation from /admin/ai visible on /resident/community, finance add tx increments balance exactly by 25.000 (12.500.000→12.525.000), monthly AI report generates all 5 sections filled + download-pdf-btn present, analytics page renders 27 SVG chart elements, mobile 390x844 bottom nav (home/reports/finance/community/profile) navigates correctly, no horizontal overflow, resident finance is read-only (no add-tx-btn), zero console errors during full admin flow.

issues: React hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Emitted from injected x-source dev instrumentation wrapping option text with a <span>; likely from build-time source-map tooling, not app code. Cosmetic in dev only.
Recharts prints width(-1)/height(-1) warning on some layouts during initial render (charts still render correctly).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /reports accepts raw dict without Pydantic validation — could tighten with a ReportIn schema (severity/rt enum, length caps already partially enforced).
GET /reports lets any authenticated caller filter by rt/status/category on their own scope; ok. Note reports/all does not paginate — fine for MVP with ~30 rows.
Analyze endpoint generates a UUID path even when upload fails and sets image_path=''; frontend properly shows 'Tanpa Foto' — verified indirectly.
CORS uses allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed cookies; set explicit origins for production.
Auth cookie is set with SameSite=None + Secure — good for cross-site preview, but token is also stored in localStorage (XSS risk). Consider consolidating.
